hints: Each update adds x to every element in [a,b], but queries ask for one point only.
Use a difference array: add x at a and subtract x just after b.
A prefix sum of differences gives the current value at a position.
analogy: Record where a range addition starts and where its effect stops; summing changes gives the point's current value.
example: Adding 4 to positions 2..4 records +4 at 2 and -4 at 5; positions 3 and 4 gain 4.
algorithm: Initialize differences from the original array. For range add [a,b] by u, diff[a]+=u and diff[b+1]-=u; for point query k, output the prefix sum through k.
correctness: The two boundary changes make the cumulative added amount increase at a and decrease after b, exactly affecting the requested interval.
complexity: O(n+q) time and O(n+q) space if storing all operations; streaming queries is possible with O(n) space.
